title: hits widget exception with table tags

comments.body:
Thanks for reporting and investigating. This seems related to #748. React complains (with a cryptic message) if we make it generate invalid markup.

This does not seem to be an issue with React itself ([official example with table](https://facebook.github.io/react/docs/thinking-in-react.html)) but maybe with the way we handle the templating. We'll have a look.
